# Attachment status listeners must keep each row attachment binding

Fresh full one-file105-line public source diff read. External attachment status listeners previously captured one mutable displayUrl that was overwritten during iteration; the change makes callbacks resolve displayUrl from their own per-iteration attachment reference. The single-attachment bar similarly uses firstAttachment. This concerns delayed listener lookup, not a global rule against shared state or a rename-only change. Fixed displayAttachmentsForExpandedViewExternal retains distinct firstAttachment and per-item const attachment bindings. Mouseover/focus reads that attachment displayUrl; mouseout/blur clears the status link. The producer decodes the external URI displaySpec for display and returns the raw URL for internal attachments. This display string is separate from the URL-loading policy and should not be mistaken for authorization to fetch it. Unavailable Bug/review context keeps this public source-only work at zero full-audit credit. No runtime or test ran.

Scope: Attachment display URL and delayed event listener binding.
